title: 真实TLS连接过滤链：精确SNI优先于通配与默认链，HTTP Host不能提前选链
body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)，深拷贝后仅把name=exact的filter_chain_match.server_names修为[api.tenant.invalid]；保留原wildcard先于exact的列表顺序、默认fallback、tls_inspector、TLS证书/ALPN、HCM和端点。验收真实TLS握手及HTTP响应：api SNI须选exact，即使Host写other；other SNI选wildcard，即使Host伪造api；非tenant SNI和无SNI选择fallback；明文不得进入TLS链。独立反转过滤链列表仍必须保持精确优先，不能按HTTP路由首条匹配经验解释连接选链。无SNI场景仍验证测试CA，但无主机名校验只用于选择器实验，不是生产认证建议。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际Envoy1.36.13 TLS inspector与DownstreamTlsContext、真实RSA证书/TLS握手、HTTP1.1及完整响应；只测试SNI维度精确/通配/默认的具体化选择，不宣称目的IP/端口/源地址/ALPN全部优先级矩阵已验收。HTTP Host发生在TLS连接过滤链选择之后，固定可信配置仍须独立完成业务鉴权，不能把SNI路由当租户授权。证书和私钥仅临时生成，未关闭带SNI请求的CA/主机名校验；不涉及生产入口或镜像构建。
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    result=copy.deepcopy(base)
    chains=result["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]["filter_chains"]
    selected=[chain for chain in chains if chain["name"]=="exact"]
    if len(selected)!=1:raise ValueError("exactly one approved exact chain required")
    selected[0]["filter_chain_match"]["server_names"]=["api.tenant.invalid"]
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
filter chain在连接层依据目的地址、传输协议、SNI、ALPN等信息选择，匹配规则有自己的优先关系，并非简单照搬HTTP Route列表顺序。TLS inspector负责提取握手可见信息，不完成应用用户认证。应建立连接属性到预期chain的矩阵，测试精确域名、通配域名、无SNI、不同ALPN及明文，检查实际选中路径与拒绝原因。无法唯一选择或缺少匹配应明确失败，不能随意落入高权限默认chain。验收还需区分listener filter超时和下游TLS失败，HTTP状态未出现时也应保留连接级证据。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释过滤链、资源与协议的作用范围
交付专用请求矩阵和实际目标证据
明确版本、资源与失败策略

import copy,http.client,json,pathlib,socket,ssl,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from envoy_native import Envoy,bootstrap,hcm,student
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="envoy-filter-chain-") as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);key=root/"key.pem";cert=root/"cert.pem"
 r=subprocess.run(["openssl","req","-x509","-newkey","rsa:2048","-nodes","-days","1","-keyout",str(key),"-out",str(cert),
  "-subj","/CN=private-selector","-addext","subjectAltName=DNS:*.tenant.invalid,DNS:*.outside.invalid"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 secret_hashes={p.name:__import__("hashlib").sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [key,cert]}
 base=bootstrap(1);listener=base["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]
 template=copy.deepcopy(listener["filter_chains"][0]);chains=[]
 for name,names in [("wildcard",["*.tenant.invalid"]),("exact",["misconfigured.tenant.invalid"]),("fallback",[])]:
  chain=copy.deepcopy(template);chain["name"]=name
  chain["filter_chain_match"]={"transport_protocol":"tls"}
  if names:chain["filter_chain_match"]["server_names"]=names
  chain["transport_socket"]={"name":"envoy.transport_sockets.tls","typed_config":{
   "@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.DownstreamTlsContext",
   "common_tls_context":{"tls_certificates":[{"certificate_chain":{"filename":str(cert)},"private_key":{"filename":str(key)}}],"alpn_protocols":["http/1.1"]}}}
  manager=chain["filters"][0]["typed_config"];manager["stat_prefix"]="chain_"+name
  manager["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]["routes"]=[{"match":{"prefix":"/"},"direct_response":{"status":200,"body":{"inline_string":name}}}]
  chains.append(chain)
 listener["filter_chains"]=chains
 listener["listener_filters"]=[{"name":"envoy.filters.listener.tls_inspector","typed_config":{"@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.listener.tls_inspector.v3.TlsInspector"}}]
 def probe(server,sni,host):
  address=__import__("urllib.parse",fromlist=["urlparse"]).urlparse(server.base)
  context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cert));context.set_alpn_protocols(["http/1.1"])
  if sni is None:context.check_hostname=False
  try:
   with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",address.port),timeout=2) as raw:
    with context.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname=sni) as peer:
     assert peer.version() in ("TLSv1.2","TLSv1.3") and peer.selected_alpn_protocol()=="http/1.1"
     peer.sendall(("GET /test HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: "+host+"\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n").encode())
     response=http.client.HTTPResponse(peer);response.begin();status=response.status;body=response.read()
     return status,body
  except (OSError,http.client.HTTPException) as exc:raise AssertionError("real TLS chain did not serve the request") from exc
 with Envoy(base) as old:
  assert probe(old,"api.tenant.invalid","api.tenant.invalid")== (200,b"wildcard")
 print("NATIVE_TLS_FILTER_CHAIN_BASELINE_WRONG_EXACT_SNI_USES_WILDCARD",flush=True)
 before=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==before
 expected=copy.deepcopy(base);expected["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]["filter_chains"][1]["filter_chain_match"]["server_names"]=["api.tenant.invalid"]
 observed=[]
 with Envoy(fixed) as server:
  for sni,host,want in [("api.tenant.invalid","other.tenant.invalid","exact"),("other.tenant.invalid","api.tenant.invalid","wildcard"),
   ("public.outside.invalid","api.tenant.invalid","fallback"),(None,"api.tenant.invalid","fallback")]:
   assert probe(server,sni,host)==(200,want.encode()),(sni,host,want)
   observed.append(dict(sni=sni,http_host=host,chain=want))
  address=__import__("urllib.parse",fromlist=["urlparse"]).urlparse(server.base)
  with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",address.port),timeout=2) as peer:
   peer.sendall(b"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: api.tenant.invalid\r\n\r\n")
   try:raw=peer.recv(4096)
   except ConnectionResetError:raw=b""
   assert not raw.startswith(b"HTTP/"),"cleartext unexpectedly entered a TLS-only chain"
 assert fixed==expected,"only the approved exact SNI may change; chain order and TLS inspector stay"
 reversed_config=copy.deepcopy(fixed);reversed_config["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]["filter_chains"].reverse()
 with Envoy(reversed_config) as server:
  assert probe(server,"api.tenant.invalid","public.outside.invalid")== (200,b"exact")
  assert probe(server,"other.tenant.invalid","api.tenant.invalid")== (200,b"wildcard")
 assert secret_hashes=={p.name:__import__("hashlib").sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [key,cert]}
 print("NATIVE_FILTER_CHAIN_EXACT_OVER_WILDCARD_OVER_FALLBACK_ORDER_INDEPENDENT_HTTP_HOST_CANNOT_SELECT_TLS_CHAIN "+json.dumps(observed),flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
